Locations.Name: Beach
Locations.Description:
A beautiful rocky beach, it's a little to cold to swim, a smell of musty seaweed is fairly strong, just enough to bother you. 
 There seems to be tide pools to the east, and a cave to the north.

Locations.Name: Entrance Hall
Locations.Description: A grand hall. Doors lead north and east.

Locations.Name: Tide Pools
Locations.Description:
The tide is low, you can see several pools that could inhabit life, but they seem to all be empty, there seems to be something poking out of the sand, a crowbar maybe? 
 You can walk west back to the main beach.

Locations.Name: Cave Entrance
Locations.Description:
You enter a dark, dingy cave, you get a feeling of unease, maybe you should turn back. 
 There is a small opening you could barely squeeze into to the north, or you could turn back to the south.

Locations.Name: Small Opening
Locations.Description:
You squeeze through the small opening, the sharp rocks from the wall stab you and latch on to your clothes. 
 You feel your way through the darkness and see a small glimmer of light to the east. Or you could find a way to squeeze back out south.

Locations.Name: Hole
Locations.Description:
There is a large rock covering what seems to be a hole in the ground. The rock is far to heavy to just life up, if only you had a tool to pry a gap. 
 It look like the hole leads south (down). Or you could go back west.

Locations.Name: Cavern
Locations.Description:
You find a way to manage prying the rock off of the hole, a dark feeling hits you when you uncover the hole. 
 You drop down into the cavern, it smells almost like sulfur mixed with blood. A strange noise echoes through the cave system, there is no way back, only forward. 
 I don't think we are alone
